en: A vintage monochrome postcard featuring a large round medieval brick tower and an ornate historic building behind a tree-lined embankment. In the foreground, several people, including children and adults, are gathered on a path in a park-like setting. The printed captions in red read "Nijmegen" at the top right and "Kronenburger Park" at the bottom center, with a small publisher's mark and number at the lower left.
